eld.text: Algenus Kenrith was chosen with Linden by the Questing Beast to quest for the high rulership, and he completed the High Quest and became High King.
The planeswalkers Oko and Garruk kidnapped him and Oko turned him into a stag.
His twins, Rowan and Will, set out to find him, and Rowan realized that the stag was her father, but at the Wild Hunt a figure looking like Queen Ayara mortally wounded the stag with an arrow.
The dying stag transformed back into Algenus, and Linden used the sword's life to return him to the living.
